cues: Rigid numbered-section structure (Summary, Context and Goals, Drivers, Current State, Assumptions, Architecture, Components, Data Design, Flows, Decisions, Cross-cutting, Build Sequence, Testing, Rollout, Risks, Deferred Work, Next Steps) reads like a prescribed template
Explicit assumptions table (A1–A8) with 'impact if wrong' and 'how/when checked', plus a closing open-questions table with defaults used and needed-by dates
Ranked quality attributes with measurable targets, and decision table (D1–D8) with options considered, reversibility and 'revisit if' triggers
Named hard parts (H1–H5) that map to spikes, risks and mitigations across sections; milestones with exit criteria, 'Out' scope, and critical path
Includes a 'Deferred Work' section with build triggers, 'Shortcuts taken on purpose', and an 'AI-specific concerns: not applicable' line, which signals a checklist-driven methodology
